verdict.rationale: Google Drive has a documented REST v3 API for its resources (docs-5, docs-29), with a dedicated upload guide covering simple, multipart and resumable uploads (docs-6, docs-23, docs-24, docs-18). Files can be listed via the files.list method (docs-10, docs-26), and the discovery document's OAuth scopes cover create and delete (docs-8). Community users report pulling Drive content programmatically with rclone (comm-13, comm-5), which corroborates retrieval outside the desktop client. Missing for 10: explicit docs for download/export endpoints, explicit docs for moving files between folders, a dedicated delete endpoint reference beyond the scope description.
